title: Open Logic Project — Türkçe Tam Sürüm / Complete Turkish Edition (OLP-0722, 722/722)
description:
Complete Turkish edition: all 722/722 frozen Open Logic Project content modules are translated and assembled as one 1,037-page linked reader. Frozen authority: commit 9620cc73f9c8e0ad003c514a5d3748f29611c4c0, tree f67757bb9305b173634082ab4cefd5601a707a34, under CC BY 4.0.

The reader passed exact source replay and structural QA for 722/722 modules, a deterministic build with exit code 0 and zero missing-character or unresolved-reference/citation diagnostics, complete text-layer residue scans, and all-page visual inspection. The editable-source and evidence packages preserve terminology, translation decisions, source-backed emendations, build/render receipts, target hashes, closure records, DOI methodology, and Turkic interlanguage research notes.

Exact release DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21927145. Stable Turkish concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21921844.

Performed at Floris’s direction by “OpenAI 5.6 Sol, Ultra mode” (“OpenAI’s current flagship model for complex work”). Human or native review is not a release gate.
